day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSanta Frances Xavier Cabrini, Intombi
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Krestu kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Krestu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umntu elungiselela uhambo olude, esongisonga iimpahla zakhe, ejonga ukuba ulishiyile na icala elinye lothando lwakhe emva. KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usibonisa umfanekiso onzulu: 'Onke umntu okwihousetop kwaye iimpahla zakhe zisekhaya, makangahli eziyokuzithatha.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYesu akathethi ngokungabi nazinto; uthetha ngokuba nentliziyo engaboshelwanga kwizinto zeli hlabathi, kodwa ekhululekileyo ukulandela ubuKumkani bukaThixo. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayeyiqonda le nyaniso ngendlela ebalaseleyo. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, ehlala ecwangcisa, ecinga ngendlela i-AI okanye i-cloud infrastructure inokusebenza ngayo, kodwa wayengazibophelelanga kwimpumelelo yeli hlabathi. Xa wayecinga ngenkampani yakhe ye-'con chim airlines', wayengayenzi ngenxa yobutyebi, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda indlela izinto ezibhabha ngayo, indlela ezikhululekileyo ngayo. Wayengumfana owayehlala ekhangela ngaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi, ekhangela ubomi obupheleleyo kuThixo.

Kodwa masiyimele inyaniso namhlanje. Alan noThao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiNcwadi ka-2 kaYohane namhlanje, sifunda amazwi asikhumbuza indlela yokuphila: 'Ndiya kucela… le ndlela esinayo kwasekuqalekeni: makusithandane.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… UYohane uthetha ngothando olungaphaya kwemithetho, uthando oluvela entliziyweni. UBen wayeyiphila le nto. Khumbula lowo mzuzu apho uBen, eneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, waxelela abazali bakhe ukuba wayezimisele ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali leyo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe: umntwana owayeselula kodwa onentliziyo enkulu eyayifuna ukunceda wonke umntu ngaphandle kokucingela yena. Oku kukunika okungenamkhawulo, oku kuthando olungaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi. UBen wayengumntwana owayephila njengombuso kaThixo ophilayo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Krestu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizimanya nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani uxolo lweNkosi, kwaye uThixo onamandla anisikelele, uYise, noNyana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKrestu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke ababuhlungu, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba elingapheliyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Ndivuye kakhulu ukufumana abanye babantwana bakho behamba enyanisweni, njengoko siyalelwe nguYise. Kodwa ngoku, Nkosikazi, ndiyakucela, kungekhona ngokungathi ndibhalela umyalelo omtsha, kodwa lowo besinawo kwasekuqalekeni: makusithandane. Kuba oku kuthando, ukuba sihambe ngokwemiyalelo yakhe; lo ngumyalelo, njengoko nivile kwasekuqalekeni, ekufuneka nihambe kuwo. Abakhohlisi abaninzi baphumile ehlabathini, abo bangavumiyo ukuba uYesu Krestu uze enyameni; onjalo ngumkhohlisi kunye nomchasi-Krestu. Zigcineni ukuze ningalahlekelwa koko sikusebenzeleyo, kodwa nifumane umvuzo opheleleyo. Nabani na othi 'phambili' kangangokuba angahlali kwimfundiso kaKrestu akanaye uThixo; ohlala kwimfundiso unaye uYise noNyana.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: Banoyolo abo balandela umthetho weNkosi! Banoyolo abo indlela yabo ingenakusoleka, abahamba emthethweni weNKOSI. Banoyolo abo bagcina imithetho yakhe, abamfuna ngentliziyo yabo yonke. Ngentliziyo yam yonke ndikufuna wena; musa ukundivumela ndilahleke kwimiyalelo yakho. Entliziyweni yam ndiyayigcina isithembiso sakho, ukuze ndingoni kuwe. Yiba nomusa kumkhonzi wakho, ukuze ndiphile ndigcine amazwi akho. Vula amehlo am, ukuze ndiqonde imimangaliso yomthetho wakho.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: “Njengoko kwakunjalo ngemihla kaNowa, koba njalo nangemihla yoNyana woMntu; babesitya, besela, betshata, besendisa, kude kwaba luhla apho uNowa wangena emkhunjini, kwaza kwafika umkhukula wabatshabalalisa bonke. Ngokufanayo, njengoko kwakunjalo ngemihla kaLote: babesitya, besela, bethenga, bethengisa, betshala, besakha; ngemini apho uLote waphumayo eSodom, kwana umlilo nesulfure ezulwini kwabatshabalalisa bonke. Koba njalo nangemini apho aya kutyhilwa ngayo uNyana woMntu. Ngaloo mini, umntu okwihousetop kwaye iimpahla zakhe zisekhaya, makangahli eziyokuzithatha, kwaye ngokunjalo lowo usemasimini makangabuyeli koko kushiywe emva. Khumbulani umfazi kaLote. Nabani na ofuna ukulondoloza ubomi bakhe uya kubulahlekelwa, kodwa nabani na obulahlekelwayo uya kubusindisa. Ndithi kuni, ngaloo busuku koba nabantu ababini kukhuko olunye; omnye uya kuthathwa, omnye ashiywe. Kwaye koba nabafazi ababini besila kunye; omnye uya kuthathwa, omnye ashiywe.” Bathi kuye besabela, “Phi, Nkosi?” Wathi kubo, “Apho isidumbu sikhoyo, apho ziya kuhlanganisana khona iintakobusi.”

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
